summary: @qlik/sdk 0.28.1 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package.json `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from a GitHub releases URL, unpacks it into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled CJS bundle at the tarball root. `math_init.js` shows heavy obfuscation (shuffled string/opcode array, hex-named identifiers, obfuscator.io fingerprints) and is not declared in the manifest's `files` field (which lists only `dist/`), yet ships in the published tarball. Executing an obfuscated bundle via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at install time bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners and hands arbitrary code execution on the installer's host to whoever controls the tarball. A Qlik SDK has no functional reason to fetch Bun and execute an out-of-manifest obfuscated bundle during install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
